notes: Every source morpheme and target token is partitioned once; the only multi-token source unit is צָפוֹנָה (noun + directive he) rendered by the single word northward, which rule 32 fuses under rule 30 and heads on the lexeme-bearing noun.
The marginal Or, to Zaphon was read and set aside; the printed text's northward governs (rule 38).

The particles together (were gathered together) and over (passedst thou over) complete lexemes the bare English verbs do not write, on the footing rule 44 gives כָּנַס → gather together; neither is a surplus particle.

The dative לְ of וְלָנוּ is unrepresented and its suffix takes the object pronoun us, which is rule 40's bare-indirect-object recasting; the fronted didst is the verb's own under rule 17, no interrogative morpheme standing in the clause.
